## 1 AirBnB Data

An initial summary of the Airbnb data set for Christchurch was produced. This gave an overview of the data including column contents, maximum and minimum values . Of particular interest was the Price column summary (Table 1), which showed that price data is missing entirely from December 2025 to February 2026. We can also see how many missing prices there are for each month that there is price data, which can help in quantifying how much data may be lost if the decision is made to remove rows with no prices during cleaning.\
\

```{r fig.align="center"}
#| label: Price summary
#| echo: false
chch_data_all <- read_csv(here("03_output","airbnb_chch_preprocessed.csv" ),show_col_types = FALSE)
price_summary <- numeric_summary(chch_data_all, price)


summary_table <- tt(price_summary,digits = 2, fontsize = 0.9,
   caption = "Summary Statistics for Christchurch Airbnb Prices" )|> 
  theme_striped()  |>   
  style_tt(fontsize = 0.7, 
           height = 0.8)

summary_table
```

\
 A full summary of the Airbnb data for Christchurch can be found in Apppedix A.

### AirBnB Median Price Christchurch central


The maximum price difference between long and short term rentals at the suburb level was found to be:

```{r}

```

```{r}
#| label: maximum price differenc suburb
#| echo: false

max_price_diff <- read_csv(here("03_output","maximum_price_difference.csv" ),show_col_types = FALSE)

max_suburb <- max_price_diff[1, c(4, 2, 7, 8)]
colnames(max_suburb) <- c("Location", "Airbnb Price (night)", "Rental Price (night)", "Price Difference (night)")


max_suburb_table <- tt(max_suburb,digits = 2, fontsize = 0.9,
                                      caption = "Median Airbnb Price, Christchurch Central" )|> 
  theme_striped()  |>   
  style_tt(fontsize = 0.7, 
           height = 0.8)

max_suburb_table

```
